response.query: Which public and private held-out datasets will be reserved for external validation, what domain-shift thresholds define acceptable generalization, and what baseline models will we compare against?
response.answer: Public held-out datasets for external validation include the MIMIC-IV dataset; private datasets are proprietary. Domain-shift thresholds for acceptable generalization are not specified. Baseline models will compare against LSTM and CNN.
